title: Enterprise workspace
subtitle: Plan, review, publish and follow up in one workspace.
error: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
emptyDescription: Start with the action above. Only real business records appear here.
startHelp: Create an enterprise or ask an administrator to add you. The enterprise feature must be enabled by the deployment administrator.
knowledgeHelp: Approved facts are the basis for content and answers. Authors cannot approve their own records unless an administrator explicitly allows it.
topicsHelp: Recommendations match your industry and service area. Sources are entered manually; this is not a live Xiaohongshu trend feed.
matchReason: Matches the enterprise industry and service area.
reviewHelp: Approval applies to this exact revision. Editing the text or replacing an image requires a new review.
knowledgeRequired: Choose an approved, unexpired source. Missing facts require human input.
imagesRequired: Upload authorized photos here or select existing assets. They are shared with the enterprise when you save the content.
previewBody: Preview your note before submitting it for review.
previewHelp: A preview is not an approval or a published note.
manualPublishHelp: Manual publishing is available. Export the approved material, publish in Xiaohongshu, then record and verify the result. Browser automation has not been enabled.
packageHelp: Publish the images in their numbered order using the approved title, body and topics. Check the account and content before submitting. Record the work link and obtain an independent verification. Do not change the approved content without a new review.
manualServiceHelp: This is a manual service workspace. Handle the original conversation in Xiaohongshu and record it here for handoff and follow-up. Direct messages, comments and miniapp service are not connected for automatic sending.
pluginHelp: A connected plugin does not imply verified automated publishing or messaging. Keep the execution device online when using browser tasks.
deliveryModeHelp: The enterprise workflow starts with controlled manual operations. Automation is enabled only after account and channel verification.
manualPublishAvailable: Approved material export and manual result verification
manualServiceAvailable: Consultation records, sales takeover and follow-up
automationUnavailable: Automatic publishing and messaging: not enabled
recentDataHelp: Counts reflect up to the latest 100 records visible to your role; they are not historical totals.
stepKnowledgeHelp: Add products, prices, cases and FAQs with evidence and an expiry date.
stepContent: Create and review a publishable note
stepContentHelp: Use approved knowledge and authorized images, then submit the exact revision for review.
stepServiceHelp: Assign an owner, confirm takeover and record the next contact.
enterpriseDisabled: This enterprise is disabled. An administrator can reactivate it in Settings.

description.overview: Focus on the work that needs your attention.
description.knowledge: One trusted source for enterprise facts.
description.topics: Find relevant ideas with a clear source.
description.content: Create with evidence. Publish after review.
description.publishing: Track each task from approved material to verified result.
description.service: Record needs, hand over and follow through.
description.settings: Manage your enterprise, members and execution conditions.

fields.title: Title
fields.images: Authorized images · select in publishing order
fields.evidence: Verification of account, note and content
fields.selfReview: Allow authors to approve their own work

noLeads: No explicit intent recorded yet. Requests for a human, quotes, appointments, purchases or volunteered contact details create traceable leads.
notificationHelp: Recorded in this workspace; external notification delivery is not configured.
replySuggestionsHelp: These are approved knowledge excerpts. Check context and send manually in the original channel.
noSuggestions: No relevant approved source was found. Ask the responsible sales person.
noExecutionDevices: No execution device is bound. A connected browser plugin is shown separately above.
resourceBindingsHelp: Only explicitly selected resources are shared. Revoking a resource blocks future use by enterprise tasks; it does not delete the original personal resource.
assetSharingHelp: Saving selected images explicitly authorizes this enterprise to use them in this content.
dataUnavailable: Data is unavailable. Use Retry above to reload.
messageHistoryHelp: Latest 100 manually recorded customer messages. This is not a live channel connection.
evidenceImages: Evidence images (optional, explicitly shared with this enterprise)
pluginApiHelp: This checks the API injected into the current website. No API can mean missing installation, missing site access, or an unsupported deployment domain.
protocolDeclaredHelp: The extension declares the review protocol. Server enablement and real account verification are still required; this does not enable automatic publishing.
manualFallbackHelp: Automatic enterprise execution is unavailable or unverified. Continue with approved material export and manual result verification.

pluginInspection.ready: Connected; capability scope must be checked

inboxUnavailable: Notifications could not be refreshed. Previous records are retained; use Refresh to retry.
templateUploadError: The image could not be saved. Check storage configuration and try again.
templateHelp: Cover, real case and FAQ layouts use approved facts and the first selected image. Case mode requires approved case knowledge and a real authorized photo. FAQ mode uses no photo. The preview follows the current theme.
templateFactsHelp: Keep complete factual conditions when shortening text. Do not invent prices, cases or guarantees. Generated images still require content review.

templateError.TEMPLATE_CANVAS_UNAVAILABLE: Image rendering is unavailable in this browser.
templateError.TEMPLATE_THEME_UNAVAILABLE: Theme is not ready. Refresh and try again.
templateError.TEMPLATE_TEXT_TOO_LONG: Text does not fit. Shorten it without removing factual conditions.
templateError.TEMPLATE_INVALID_IMAGE: The source image is unavailable. Choose an authorized image again.
templateError.TEMPLATE_PHOTO_REQUIRED: Choose a real authorized case photo first.
templateError.TEMPLATE_CONTEXT_CHANGED: The enterprise or login changed. Reopen the editor.
templateError.TEMPLATE_IMAGE_LIMIT: Remove an image before adding a template.

queueEmptyHelp: Clear the task-status filter above to see other records.
usageNotConnected: Provider usage and cost metering are not connected. Missing cost is not shown as zero. Select and configure the enterprise model service before enabling provider-based generation or billing.
photoLimitHelp: Remove an image or choose fewer files before uploading.
photoFormatHelp: Choose an image format supported by the platform.
photoUploadError: The upload could not be confirmed. Check storage and try again.
generationHelp: Use the configured planner to arrange verbatim excerpts of selected approved sources. Add brand template images, save and submit for review.
missingSourceHelp: Missing price, case or brand evidence is never invented. Add and approve the source first.
generationRetryHelp: The attempt failed or is unconfirmed. Generate again explicitly to record another attempt; unknown charges need provider reconciliation.
generationError: Could not retrieve a result. Check the usage list before retrying.
usageLedgerHelp: Each attempt records the model and available metering. Unreconciled costs remain unknown. Shows the latest 100 attempts.
